purpose: No getter before upper THROW: real refresh to the owning middle, supplied Throwable identity/getters and a held current snapshot across explicit close.
source:
<?php
class PendingChainThrowCache32 { function __destruct() { echo "A|"; } }
class PendingChainThrowReturn32 { function __destruct() { echo "R|"; } }
function pendingChainThrowChild32() { echo "C|"; yield new PendingChainThrowCache32(); echo "L|"; return new PendingChainThrowReturn32(); }
function pendingChainThrowMiddle32() { try { echo "M|"; $reply = yield from $GLOBALS["child"]; echo "BAD-MIDDLE|"; } finally { echo "J|"; } }
function pendingChainThrowUpper32() { try { echo "U|"; yield from $GLOBALS["middle"]; echo "BAD-UPPER|"; } finally { echo "K|"; } }
function pendingChainThrowOuter32() { try { echo "O|"; yield from $GLOBALS["upper"]; echo "BAD-OUTER|"; } finally { echo "F|"; } }
$child = pendingChainThrowChild32(); $middle = pendingChainThrowMiddle32(); $upper = pendingChainThrowUpper32(); $outer = pendingChainThrowOuter32();
echo "P|"; $outer->rewind(); $child->next(); unset($child); echo "H|"; $injected = new Exception("supplied32");
echo "T|"; try { $unused = $upper->throw($injected); echo "BAD-RETURN|"; } catch (Throwable $caught) { echo "CALLER|", $caught === $injected ? 1 : 0, "|", $caught->getPrevious() === null ? 1 : 0, "|"; }
echo "GET|", $upper->valid() ? 1 : 0, "|", $middle->valid() ? 1 : 0, "|", $upper->key() === null ? 1 : 0, "|"; $held = $upper->current(); echo "HELD|", $held instanceof PendingChainThrowCache32 ? 1 : 0, "|";
unset($caught, $injected); echo "EX|"; unset($outer); echo "OUT|"; unset($upper); echo "UP|"; unset($middle); echo "MID|"; unset($held); echo "HELD-DROP|"; echo "E";

purpose: Selected upper survives argument-helper alias removal; distinct cache destructor can replace the supplied Throwable while the owning copied return remains separate.
source:
<?php
class PendingChainThrowLate32 { function __destruct() { echo "R|"; } }
class PendingChainThrowReplaceCache32 { function __destruct() { echo "D|"; throw new RuntimeException("replacement32"); } }
function pendingChainThrowDropRoots32($exception) { echo "DROP|"; unset($GLOBALS["outer"], $GLOBALS["upper"], $GLOBALS["middle"], $GLOBALS["child"]); echo "CLEARED|"; return $exception; }
function pendingChainThrowReplaceChild32() { echo "C|"; yield new PendingChainThrowReplaceCache32(); echo "L|"; return [new PendingChainThrowLate32()]; }
function pendingChainThrowReplaceMiddle32() { try { echo "M|"; $reply = yield from $GLOBALS["child"]; echo "BAD-MIDDLE|"; } finally { echo "J|"; } }
function pendingChainThrowReplaceUpper32() { try { echo "U|"; yield from $GLOBALS["middle"]; echo "BAD-UPPER|"; } finally { echo "K|"; } }
function pendingChainThrowReplaceOuter32() { try { echo "O|"; yield from $GLOBALS["upper"]; echo "BAD-OUTER|"; } finally { echo "F|"; } }
$child = pendingChainThrowReplaceChild32(); $middle = pendingChainThrowReplaceMiddle32(); $upper = pendingChainThrowReplaceUpper32(); $outer = pendingChainThrowReplaceOuter32();
echo "P|"; $outer->rewind(); $child->next(); echo "H|", $upper->current() instanceof PendingChainThrowReplaceCache32 ? 1 : 0, "|"; unset($child); $injected = new Exception("supplied32"); echo "T|";
try { $unused = $upper->throw(pendingChainThrowDropRoots32($injected)); echo "BAD-RETURN|"; } catch (Throwable $caught) { echo "CALLER|", $caught instanceof RuntimeException ? 1 : 0, "|", $caught->getPrevious() === $injected ? 1 : 0, "|"; }
unset($caught, $injected); echo "E";
